text:
Maya S.: Quick heads-up — planning a staggered ramp of the 'cobalt' dedicated GPU pool tonight at 22:00 UTC. Goal is to increase capacity for a new customer commit without spiking costs.

Maya S.: Ramp plan: 30% -> 60% -> 100% over ~20m with 5m bake between steps. Autoscale smoothing reduced during ramp. Full rollback plan included. Posting preflight checklist below, ping who can own smoke and rollback.

Ravi K.: I can own smoke tests. Will be available from 21:45 UTC. What metrics do you want me watching?

Maya S.: Thanks Ravi. Watch p95 latency, queue length, OOMs, and attach per-model token/sec. Dashboards: /console/models/cobalt/observability and /console/pools/cobalt/capacity.

Sam B.: I'll push the policy change and the pool config. Code review is green (PR #4821). CI showed allocation tests passing.

Maya S.: Great. Sam, I'll need the exact patch applied so Zoe can verify and trigger. Also include the autoscaler params we're changing.

Sam B.: Patch snippet (will apply after handoff):
```yaml
pool: cobalt
min_replicas: 4
max_replicas: 24
autoscaler:
  smoothing_window: 15s  # lowered for faster ramp reactions
  step_scale: 0.3       # scale to 30% increments during ramp
  cooldown: 60s
```

Sam B.: Also enabling 'burst-eviction: false' for the first 30m to avoid noisy preemption.

Zoe (oncall): I can be primary rollback. If p95 > 450ms or error-rate > 1.5% for two consecutive 1m windows during a step, we roll back to previous policy. I'll run the rollback command.

Ravi K.: For smoke I have a short runbook:
1) run load against canary models: `make smoke-cobalt TARGET=canary --duration=120s`
2) verify traces for tokenize/encode spikes
3) confirm KV hit-rate doesn't drop below 85%

Maya S.: Adding traffic shaping plan: route 10% prod traffic to cobalt at 22:02 UTC (after first step), then 40% at 22:08, 100% at 22:22. If any step fails we hold and escalate.

infra-bot: Scheduled job created: `deploy-cobalt-ramp` starting 22:00 UTC, steps: [22:00,22:05,22:10], job id: job-cc-8443.

Sam B.: Applying PR now to staging, will promote to prod at 21:55 if staging smoke looks good.

Ravi K.: Staging smoke passed at 21:35 — p95 stayed ~180ms, no errors.

Maya S.: Awesome. Final checklist for tonight:
- [x] PR merged to main (#4821)
- [x] staging smoke pass (Ravi)
- [ ] prod deploy window (22:00) — Sam to apply
- [ ] smoke (22:03) — Ravi to run and report
- [ ] metrics guard (Zoe) — rollback if thresholds tripped
- [ ] post-mortem if rollback or >10% cost variance

Zoe (oncall): I'm in the call channel at 21:50. Will post `rollback-cobalt` run output if triggered.

Maya S.: If anyone needs to tweak step sizes, shout now. Otherwise we'll proceed as planned. :rocket:

infra-bot: Job job-cc-8443 started at 22:00:00 UTC (initiated by Sam B.).

Ravi K.: 22:03 smoke result: basic end-to-end checks OK, p95 195ms, error-rate 0.2%. Proceeding to step 2.

infra-bot: Step 2 (increase to 60%) applied at 22:08:10 UTC.

Zoe (oncall): Monitoring — p95 jumped to 310ms for 1m, then settled to 210ms. No errors. Keeping watch.

Maya S.: Hold thresholds met, proceeding to full ramp at 22:22.

infra-bot: Final step complete at 22:22:40 UTC. Pool cobalt at 100% target capacity.

Ravi K.: Post-ramp quick smoke: p95 205ms, error-rate 0.3%, KV hit 88%. Looks healthy.

Sam B.: Thanks everyone. I'll leave the smoothing_window at 15s for 1h then revert to 60s. I'll open a follow-up PR to revert the temporary burst flags.

Maya S.: Closing notes: no rollback needed, cost delta within expected bounds (~6% for the hour). Filing post-deploy note to #deploy-ops. Good job team. :tada:
